system.description:
You create a single star shaped earth structure 1 mile in the air before you cause it to shatter.

Select a point you can see within range. All creatures of your choice within 120 feet of the selected point must make a Strength saving throw as the weight of a dying star is thrust upon them.

On a failed save they are Stunned and knocked Prone as they become unable to move and find it hard to even breathe.

A creature who begins their turn in this space, ends their turn in this space, or enters this space for the first time must make the Strength saving throw.

A creature Stunned by this jutsu that begins or ends its turn in the affected area takes 6d12 earth damage.

A Stunned creature makes a Strength Saving throw at the end of their turns and do not automatically fail as a result of being Stunned. On a successful save, they end the Stunned condition on themselves immediately.
